However, I might have been better to set boundaries earlier, like letting her know I was on sick leave and couldn't handle more work. But given the situation, I think ignoring the messages was the right choice to prioritize my health. I also consider that in a professional setting, communication is key. Maybe I should have responded once to explain my situation, but given that I was sick and needed rest, it's understandable that I didn't. It's possible that my senior associate didn't realize how unwell I was, so setting clear boundaries in the future could help prevent this from happening again. In conclusion, while ignoring the messages might seem like not fulfilling my duties, my health and well-being are more important, especially when I was already overworked. It's a tough balance, but in this case, I think it was the right decision.
